manual.title: User Manual & Guides
manual.accountsDesc: You can create multiple accounts (e.g., Main, Challenge). Each account has its own initial balance and trade history. You can filter the dashboard and charts by selecting an account from the Sidebar or Top Menu on mobile.
manual.dateRangeDesc: Use the 1W, 1M, YTD, or All filters to adjust the data shown on the Dashboard and Trades table. It instantly recalculates your PnL and win rates.
manual.analyticsDesc: The Analytics tab provides a visual representation of your Equity Curve, Win Rate distribution, and average profit/loss to help you find your edge.
manual.sampleDataDesc: If your dashboard is empty, you can click "Add Sample Trades" to instantly populate it with dummy data so you can test out the charts and features.
manual.alphaPicksDesc: Use this module for Long-Term Investing. When you buy more shares of an existing position, the system automatically calculates your new Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA). When you scale out (sell), it records the realized profit without altering your core average cost.
manual.weeklyPlannerDesc: Plan your swing trades logically. Log your Entry Alert and Stop Loss. You can now click the Chart Icon 📈 to view the historical OHLC chart with automated markers pointing precisely to the date you logged the pick.
manual.netRMultiple: Net R-Multiple: Total Risk/Reward achieved from all trades.
manual.profitFactor: Profit Factor: Gross profit divided by gross loss (should be > 1.0).
manual.maxDrawdown: Max Drawdown: Maximum observed loss from a peak to a trough of a portfolio.
manual.expectancy: Expectancy: Average profitability per trade (positive indicates long-term edge).
manual.avgWinLoss: Avg Win / Avg Loss: Average profit per winning trade / Average loss per losing trade.
manual.largestWinLoss: Largest Win / Largest Loss: Highest profit / Highest loss in a single trade.
manual.winRate: Win Rate (L/S): Win percentage categorized by Long and Short trades.
manual.streaks: Streaks (W / L): Longest consecutive winning (W) and losing (L) streaks.
manual.avgExitEfficiency: Avg Exit Efficiency: Exit performance compared to Maximum Favorable Excursion (MFE).
manual.totalTrades: Total Trades: Total number of closed trades.
manual.planAdherence: Plan Adherence: Percentage of trades strictly following your plan.
manual.avgHoldTime: Avg Hold Time: Average time trades are held before closing.
manual.aiInsights: AI Behavioral Insights: Preliminary AI recommendations on trading behavior (e.g. FOMO warnings).
